content:
We have sulfonamide formation template reaction_id 733 (template for sulfonamide from sulfonyl chloride and aniline). Good.

Now we have amide formation template IDs from earlier search: reaction_id 401931 seems amide formation (maybe from acid chloride and amine). We'll use that.

Now construct JSON route.

Root molecule target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

First reaction (sulfonamide formation) template_id 733, children: precursor sulfonyl chloride (SMILES: O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccc(NC(=O)C=CC)cc1) and p-toluidine (Cc1ccc(N)cc1).

Second reaction (amide formation) template_id 401931, children: 4-aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride (O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccc(N)cc1) and trans-cinnamoyl chloride (C=CC(=O)Cl).

Check SMILES for trans-cinnamoyl chloride: C=CC(=O)Cl (that's correct). For 4-aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride: O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccc(N)cc1.

Now ensure leaves are commercially available. Likely yes.

Now produce final JSON.
